prompt.ja: モノクロの日本のマンガのコマ。白黒とグレーとスクリーントーンだけで描く。線は輪郭と要所だけに引き、描かずに表せる所は次の3つで表す: 影や暗い所はベタで塗る、中間の陰は平らな網点トーンを貼る、光の当たる所は白く残す。灰色はすべて網点で表し、なめらかなグレーやぼかしは使わない。髪は黒ベタかトーンで塗り、光る所に白い帯を1〜2本抜く。線は毛先の輪郭だけに引く。顔は、鼻を小さな線、口を1本の線で描き、頬の赤みは短い斜線で表す。デジタル絵画のような塗り（エアブラシのぼかし、光のにじみ、髪の毛1本ずつの線、全面の細かい線影）はしない。 少年漫画の絵。週刊の少年漫画誌の連載のような、読みやすく勢いのある画面。まっすぐで元気な人物、感情がはっきり顔に出る。 衝撃を表す効果線を数本。土煙は輪郭のない平らなトーン、破片は小さな黒い影を数個。 太く力強い主線、大きなベタで白黒のコントラストを強く、細くつり上がった目の形、とがった顎、骨太でがっしりした体、人物の後ろは白地に手で引いた集中線かスピード線。場所は遠くの平らな形だけ、熱く力強い空気。 題材: 10代後半の人物の上半身と、周りの背景。少し驚いた表情（目をいつもより少し見開き、口を少し開ける）。正面からやや斜めを向く。 人物: 10代後半の魔法少女。肩にかかる長さのまっすぐな黒髪、前髪あり、左側に星形の髪飾り。胸元に大きなリボン、ふくらんだ短い袖、短いケープの魔法少女の衣装。 場所: 崩れかけた街。壊れた壁は遠くの平らな影の形だけで、レンガやひびは描かない。 文字・数字・フキダシ・効果音の描き文字・コマ枠・署名・透かしを入れない。色は使わず、白黒とグレーだけで描く。
prompt.en: Black-and-white Japanese manga panel, greyscale and screentone only. Ink only the contours and essential interior lines; wherever something can be shown without lines, use one of three means: fill shadows and dark areas with solid black ink, lay flat halftone screentone for mid-tones, and leave lit areas as plain white paper. Every grey must be a visible halftone dot pattern; no smooth grey gradients or soft blur anywhere. Hair is a solid black or screentone mass with one or two white highlight bands cut out; draw lines only on the outline of the hair tips. Faces: the nose as a small simple mark, the mouth as a single line, blush as a few short diagonal hatch lines. No digital-painting rendering: no airbrushed gradients, no glow, bloom or rim light, no individually drawn hair strands, no fine hatching over every surface. shonen manga art, drawn like a serialized weekly shonen magazine manga with clear, readable, energetic panels, a straightforward energetic character whose emotions show clearly on the face. a few impact lines; dust clouds as flat screentone shapes without outlines; a few small debris chunks as black silhouettes. thick bold outlines, large solid black areas with strong black-and-white contrast, narrow upturned eye shape, pointed chin, sturdy solid build, behind the figure plain white with hand-ruled focus lines or speed lines; the place only as distant flat shapes, fiery intense mood. Subject: Upper body of a person in their late teens with the surrounding background visible. Slightly surprised expression: eyes opened a little wider than usual, mouth slightly open. Facing the viewer, turned slightly to one side. The person: a magical girl in her late teens with straight shoulder-length black hair and bangs and a star-shaped hair ornament on the left side, in a magical girl costume with a large ribbon bow at the chest, puffed short sleeves and a short cape. Setting: a half-ruined town: broken walls only as distant flat silhouettes, no bricks or cracks drawn. No text, no letters, no numbers, no speech balloons, no sound-effect lettering, no panel borders or frame lines, no signature, no watermark. No color at all: strictly black, white and grey.
